text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Reporter Otonashi brings me magazine articles on the Twinkle Star Climax to show me how publicity efforts are going.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taken aback at the scale of the event, I eagerly flip through the articles and find one on <chrname> alongside other eminent Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're not there yet, though. We need to keep forging ahead if we want to enter the Twinkle Star Climax!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: <chrname> and I vow to both do our best and aim for the title of "greatest"!
